scope: All closed repository issues at capture; pull requests are separate. Closure is interpreted within the recorded boundary, not as production readiness.

issues.title: Factory materialisation: separate public intent from private child exit packages
issues.delivered: Separate public Factory intents/possession receipts from private child exits; preserve owner-only delivery and recovery artifacts.
issues.boundary: Child exit signatures never enter parent public requests.

issues.title: Signing CLI: remove private keys from argv and support protected key input
issues.delivered: Remove participant/wallet private-key argv and raw-secret environment entry points; use protected key files.
issues.boundary: Protected input is currently Linux-specific; no insecure fallback.

issues.title: Factory contracts: harden delegated verification and cross-script-group invariants
issues.delivered: Harden delegated contract validation, authentic authority selection, complete custody and cross-script-group negative cases.
issues.boundary: Delegation authenticates mandatory immutable code; it does not omit physical conservation.

issues.title: Factory signers: implement independent durable journals and private exit delivery before approval
issues.delivered: Independent durable Factory member/child journals, crash-safe signature reservation and private exit delivery before parent approval.
issues.boundary: Possession attestations rely on honest child persistence; they do not prove everlasting data availability.

issues.title: Factory CLI: implement native multi-asset creation, activation, and materialisation submission
issues.delivered: Native Factory root, activation, metadata, retained/terminal materialisation, wallet funding, keyless submission and child recovery.
issues.boundary: Actual admitted shapes remain narrower than all parser maxima.

issues.title: Deployment policy: qualify one current custody envelope and explicit admission limits
issues.delivered: One current custody envelope with exact-request admission, lifetime reservations and canonical/reorg-aware accounting.
issues.boundary: Controlled no-value scope only; owner removed external-operator/external-record prerequisites.

issues.title: Supply chain: upgrade the RustCrypto signing stack and remove the RUSTSEC-2026-0387 waiver
issues.delivered: Upgrade RustCrypto signing and Biscuit; remove the two resolved crypto advisory waivers.
issues.boundary: The deprecated vulnerable stack is not retained as a compatibility path.

issues.title: Supply chain: upgrade CKB dependencies and the toolchain to close faster-hex and removable legacy waivers
issues.delivered: Upgrade CKB dependencies and Rust 1.95 toolchain; record reviewed vendor patches and remove obsolete waivers.
issues.boundary: The documented upstream rand 0.7 waiver remains; closed does not mean zero waivers.

issues.title: Current capability bounds: qualify admitted joint exits and retained floors
issues.delivered: Qualify bounded admitted exits, claim backing, payout geometry, retained floors and exact resource shapes.
issues.boundary: Not a proof every arbitrary legal rights allocation/asset topology can independently liquidate the last floor.

issues.title: Runtime storage: add a transactional boundary for coordinated node state
issues.delivered: Introduce transactional SQLite runtime families, revisions and atomic exact intent/outbox updates with current-schema validation.
issues.boundary: A runtime database or its backup never replaces the monotonic signer journal.

issues.title: Signing: add a role-bound external signer protocol and isolated implementation
issues.delivered: Provide role-bound participant signer review and bounded private Linux IPC with timeout/lost-response/crash recovery.
issues.boundary: Existing reservations survive uncertainty; no automatic local-key fallback or hardware-wallet claim.

issues.title: API: versioned public Rust types, checked schemas and Rust clients
issues.delivered: Make public Rust DTOs/errors authoritative; generate checked schemas and reuse typed SDK/GPUI contracts.
issues.boundary: The earlier TypeScript-output proposal was superseded by the owner’s Rust-only client decision.

issues.title: Observability: add bounded metrics and mutation readiness separate from liveness
issues.delivered: Bound observability and authenticated mutation readiness independently of process liveness, with scope/freshness checks.
issues.boundary: Readiness is neither signer authority nor a guarantee of pooled failover.

issues.title: Fiber bridge: implement the external-edge hook and canonical shadow-mode service
issues.delivered: Implement pinned Fiber external-edge hook and canonical, durable nonforwarding shadow coordination/service.
issues.boundary: Diagnostic mirrors do not route payments or create liquidity/settlement evidence.

issues.title: Verification: require bounded parser fuzzing and real-process crash recovery gates in CI
issues.delivered: Add bounded parser/mutation, real-process crash/recovery and I/O fault evidence with reproducible budgets.
issues.boundary: 780,000 bounded host mutations are not VM executions, coverage-guided proof or a universal security claim.

issues.title: Release evidence: publish a versioned machine-checked node and integration manifest
issues.delivered: Bind source, schemas, node/Fiber identities, ELFs, policy, client bundles and per-gate receipts in machine-checked evidence.
issues.boundary: Previous candidates retain their own identities; skipped/stopped runs are not relabelled passes.

issues.title: Factory reduced rights: qualify native publication through the sole current capability
issues.delivered: Publish current one/four/ten-right reduced updates through native prepare, independent signing, funding and proof refresh.
issues.boundary: Uses the sole compact current frame; no parallel historical reduced protocol.

issues.title: Accepted: explicit bilateral cooperative terminal close
issues.delivered: Implement exact-body bilateral cooperative terminal close, retained replacement attempts, source races and conditional/child recovery.
issues.boundary: Native CLI consensus/signing/operation scope is implemented; generic send/RBF and all UI/API adapters are not implied.

issues.title: Double-spend review: qualify typed capabilities, freshness, signer rollback and exact custody
issues.delivered: Review current typed authority, exact custody, roles, stale settlement, replay and rollback assumptions; bind acceptance to source.
issues.boundary: Local hashes/fsync cannot detect rollback of the entire authority store without independent freshness.

issues.title: Funding: retire obsolete shapes and enforce initial-exit recovery on the sole current path
issues.delivered: Retire obsolete funding shapes; require complete initial exits and support withheld-receipt, offline recovery and exact orphan replay.
issues.boundary: No missing-field migration, second authority initialisation or journal reset.

issues.title: Optimize current protocol parsing, witness bytes and duplicated verification
issues.delivered: Cache validated conditional views; compact Script/condition/right transport; authenticate one mandatory close/splice verifier; refresh resource evidence.
issues.boundary: Preserve 256-bit commitments, independent signatures, u128 amounts, conservation and complete private recovery.
